title: TaxGeoConfig - Data API
description: Represents a tax configuration associated with a GeoCountry. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.

GeoCountryId.description: The GeoCountry associated with the TaxGeoConfig. This field is a relationship field.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed data in this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, it's possible the user accessed data in this record or list view but didn't view it directly.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The owner of the TaxGeoConfig record. By default, the asset owner is the user who created the record. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

RoundingStrategyType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
RoundingStrategyType.description: Specifies the tax rounding strategy associated with the TaxGeoConfig. Possible values are: Rounding Down Rounding Off Rounding Up The default value is Rounding Off.

special_access_rules: The TaxGeoConfig object is available if B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce is enabled.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **TaxGeoConfigShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
